race.comment: Open race to close out the card. BETTERLUCKNEXTTIME (1) has a win and a second from two attempts over this course and distance and gets some well-needed weight relief with the 2kg claim. Will be cherry-ripe fit for this and looks the one they all have to run down. GOODNIGHT ROMEO (12) was too bad to be true at the latest effort but go on the solid win here two back. Can bounce right back without surprising. STOKOMO (4) gets the services of Holt in the saddle and is more than capable enough on his day. Top-three contender on best figures. CARPACCIO (3) should get a cosy run in transit from the inside marble and will give backers a sight. KOBAYASTAR (10) rounds out the selections.
